record.question: What is the main advantage of FNAC over a core needle biopsy?
options: Provides better architectural detail of the lesion.
Less invasive, quicker, and generally less painful.
Provides a definitive diagnosis for all types of tumors.
Carries a higher risk of complications.
record.explanation: Answer B: Less invasive, quicker, and generally less painful.. FNAC is generally less invasive, faster and less painful, but yields less tissue architecture than core biopsy. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
